meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: 它把工作拆成超细步骤:先登记目标,再把每个动作同步进 update_plan 清单,同一时刻只保留一项进行中;每条成功标准都要有可观察证据,如终端、浏览器或命令行输出,并绑定当时的代码树。
howto.when: 当你说「ulw-loop」「ulw」等关键词,或要求带检查点、可持续恢复的目标执行时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 起一个目标循环,先登记目标和成功标准。
say.note: 会先按 define-goal 参考创建目标

say.text: 把这个任务拆成超细步骤,同步到 update_plan 清单。
say.note: 每个动作一步,只有一项进行中

say.text: 上下文压缩后重新读目标和账本,再继续执行。
say.note: 按 session id 恢复,不从头重规划

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes work into ultra-granular steps: it registers the goal first, mirrors each action into the update_plan checklist with one in_progress, and demands observable evidence (terminal, browser, CLI) bound to the code tree.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop, ulw, or durable checkpointed goal execution.

say_en.text: Start a ulw-loop goal and register the objective and success criteria.
say_en.note: Reads define-goal and creates the goal first

say_en.text: Break this task into ultra-granular steps and sync them to update_plan.
say_en.note: One action per step, one in_progress

say_en.text: After compaction, re-read the goals and ledger, then resume.
say_en.note: Resumes with the session id instead of re-planning
